text:
sahil: Heads-up: Catalyst Health kickoff Friday 9:30am PT. Creating quick thread for final runbook: success criteria, data handling, security asks, and pricing outline.

nora: I'll take the demo and evauation cells. Where are the customer prompts?

kevin: Customer said they can supply redacted clinical notes. Nora—expect a secure transfer. We need to clarify whether PHI is fully removed.

sahil: @gwen can you confirm what SSO we support? Customer requested Okta + SCIM user provisioning and asked whether we can integrate with their HSM for key storage.

gwen: Okta + SCIM yes. HSM/BYOK requires Private deployment or Dedicated with KMS integration. I'll prepare the exact matrix we can share.

nora: Success criteria they requested: 1) extraction accuracy > 0.75 F1 for ICD code identification, 2) end-to-end p95 latency < 300ms for 256 token average, 3) no > 1% hallucination rate on structured fields. Are we comfortable committing to that for a POC?

kevin: Extraction target maybe tight but doable with a small finetune or few-shot templates. Hallucination measurement method needs to be agreed (manual review vs rule-based).

sahil: For pricing, they asked for a 6-week POC estimate. They expect usage ~80k tokens/day with occasional spikes to 200k/day. We'll propose hosted credits + optional Dedicated trial pricing.

gwen: I'll also note procurement likely needs SOC2 + signed DPA. We'll attach SOC2 and our DPA template.

kevin: Action items: Nora: prepare the eval harness and bring three representative prompts. Sahil: draft provisional POC SOW with timeline and acceptance criteria. Gwen: produce security matrix showing supported integrations and any restrictions.

sahil: Agenda for Friday: intros (5m), customer objectives & data (10m), security & compliance Qs (10m), demo + perf estimates (25m), pricing & contractual next steps (10m).

integration-bot: Zoom link and calendar invite created.

sahil: If any one has blockers, speak now. Otherwise we'll finalize materials by EOD Thursday.

nora: I'll ping when eval harness is ready, aiming for two different model configs and a small shard of their redacted notes.

kevin: Also suggest we capture a short runbook for accidental PHI discovery and data deletion steps to reassure legal.

sahil: Good call. I'll add that to the SOW. See you Friday.
